description: This Java enum defines different types of recalculation frequencies related to loan interest recalculation, providing methods to interpret and compare these frequency types.

classes.name: RecalculationFrequencyType
classes.description: An enum representing different recalculation frequencies for interest, with utility methods for interpretation and comparison.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer value to its corresponding RecalculationFrequencyType enum, returning INVALID if null or not found.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the frequency type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the frequency type.

methods.name: isSameAsRepayment
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is the same as the repayment period.

methods.name: isDaily
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is daily.

methods.name: isWeekly
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is weekly.

methods.name: isMonthly
methods.description: Checks if the frequency type is monthly.

methods.name: isSameFrequency
methods.description: Compares the frequency type with a PeriodFrequencyType to determine if they match.
